description: Synthetic study code, one per country: SYNBWA, SYNMOZ, SYNMWI, SYNNAM, SYNZAF, SYNZMB, SYNZWE
Salted hash, 16 characters. One per pregnancy. The mother's PT ID is used unchanged on her child's rows
Date of the event. Birth date for delivery outcomes, LMP date for lnmp, blank for booking variables
STUDYCODE_xx, for example SYNZAF_17. Health facility where the woman booked. See locations.csv
ZAF, NAM, BWA, ZWE, ZMB, MWI, MOZ
Maternal age in whole years at booking (14 to 48)
Body mass index at booking, one decimal
Haemoglobin under 11.0 g/dL at booking, coded before haemoglobin was rounded to one decimal, so a woman shown as exactly 11.0 can be either
Socio-economic grade, quintiles of a household wealth score
Household uses an unimproved water source
Antenatal visits over the whole pregnancy
Gestational age at birth in days (154 to 314)
Completed weeks of gestation at birth (gest_age_delivery_days // 7)
